title: 1985 Topps All Star #719 Gary Carter Expos
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1985 Topps All Star #719 Gary Carter Expos trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. Featuring the Montreal Expos player in his iconic uniform, this sports trading card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) league and manufactured by Topps. The card is a part of the base set and does not have any autographs or special features. 

The card number is 719 and it is from the 1985 season. It is a single trading card and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Add this Gary Carter Expos trading card to your collection and relive the excitement of the 1980s baseball era.
